headline: Mid-pullback after a parabolic 2-day rally off the $1.49 low

meta.market_state_note: Explosive 2-day expansion off the low, now in its first pullback — favours a pullback-continuation long, but post-parabolic dips overshoot, so the setup is valid yet not actionable at spot. Wait for the retest.

factors.evidence: 60-day trend is down (3.126 → 1.487, -28%), but the last 3 days printed an explosive reversal that broke the local lower-high sequence and reclaimed $2.00+. Larger trend down, near-term structure flipped up.
Price hovering around the slower EMA after the rally; not cleanly above.

factors.evidence: Anchored to the cycle low, price is well above AVWAP (bullish); anchored to the high, still below. Direction-dependent.
Recovered off oversold back above the midline — regime turning up.
The two rally days printed 213M & 215M vs 41M avg (~5x) — overwhelming buy-side participation.
+31% on the week with HH/HL; now making a lower high (2.396 → 2.288) and pulling back. Trend intact, momentum stalling.
Price holds above the rally AVWAP.
Above midline but rolling over from overbought — cooling, not yet bearish.

factors.reading: Pullback ~ in line with rally bars
factors.evidence: Down bar 23M vs up bars ~25M — no clean contraction yet; pullback isn't fully exhausted.

setup.type: Pullback / Trend Continuation — long, WAIT for the retest
setup.thesis: Long the pullback into the $1.93–2.01 breakout/EMA shelf (on a hold/reclaim, not a falling-knife grab), targeting the retest of the $2.29 supply and then the $2.40 high. No entry at $2.097 — it's mid-air.
setup.not: Not a Breakout (no fresh push); not a Failed Breakout (no acceptance back below the shelf).

verdict.rationale: The metrics are on the bulls' side; the location is not. Don't chase $2.10 mid-air — let price come into $1.93–2.01 and hold before engaging; chasing the middle of a post-parabolic pullback is the trap.

Above the 4H rally AVWAP from the $1.587 low; near/above the daily means
Today's drop to $2.063 swept intraday lows then recovered — minor, not a clean structural sweep
Defined shelf $1.93–2.01 (breakout + EMAs) below; supply $2.29–2.40 above

analyst_summary: TRUMP is bullish (6/10, zero bearish factors): a violent 2-day rally took it from ~$1.64 to a $2.40 high on ~5x normal volume, and price still holds above both the daily ($1.927) and 4H ($2.014) fast EMAs. The caveat is that this is a fresh, stretched impulse sitting inside a still-down 60-day trend — not an established uptrend.

The flow confirms the move: OI expanded +43% into the rally (real new money), CVD rose strongly with price (real buying), and the current pullback is deleveraging (OI easing, not fresh shorts) into mildly-negative funding (squeeze fuel). The dominant edge is a pullback-continuation long.

Net read is WAIT — at $2.097 price is mid-air between the $2.29 supply and the $1.93–2.01 support shelf, with no clean entry. Buy a hold/reclaim of the $1.93–2.01 shelf (stop <$1.88, targets $2.29 then $2.40); a 4H close below $1.90 says the parabola failed and it's mean-reverting to $1.74.

Notes: this is a news/event-driven coin — the +45% spike on 5x volume is catalyst-driven, so headline risk cuts both ways and can void any level instantly; size accordingly. The OI signature is the standout tell — OI expanded into the rally and is only contracting on the pullback (profit-taking, not distribution); watch for OI to re-expand as price reclaims $2.20 to confirm the second leg. The week-long CVD direction is reliable; the precise per-bar low-vs-now divergence read was noisy in the feed, so I'm leaning on the directional conclusion.
bottom_line: Bullish pullback-continuation long — but a WAIT: the metrics back the bulls, the location doesn't. Let price come into $1.93–2.01 and hold; chasing $2.10 mid-air is the trap.

bull_case: Volume-, OI- and CVD-confirmed breakout off the $1.49 low holding above the 4H 20 EMA, with a deleveraging pullback into mildly-negative funding — a dip into $1.93–2.01 is a high-quality continuation-long location toward $2.29/$2.40.
bear_case: Parabolic blow-off inside a still-bearish 60-day trend — a 4H lower high, rolling RSI and today's −8% rejection bar warn of exhaustion, with post-parabolic pullbacks prone to overshoot toward the $1.74 origin.
